L1_plan_A_expected_chrono_minus_referenc.model: Nonlinear statics of the L1 Chrono pad model on a tilted rigid plane (top level), body start level at the origin. Rigid body = superstructure + 4 rods at ext_sph (rigid motor). Sphere radius h_b centred at the ball; the floor plane holds the pad bottoms at ext_pad, so the spheres touch it exactly with ext_sph. Normal force k_n x penetration along n through the ball centre; bushing k_t in the plane between a body-fixed point (ball centre, or the start contact point if bushing_at_ball is False) and its start position (stick). Gravity -g z (x gscale).
L1_plan_A_expected_chrono_minus_referenc.plan: plan A (user decision 2026-10-20): bushing at the ball centre -> the whole floor reaction passes through the swivel centre as in the reference static_slope_10dof; the remaining Chrono - reference difference is the geometric nonlinearity (P-delta) only
L1_plan_A_expected_chrono_minus_referenc.extension_used: extension_sphere_touch_m (spheres touch the plane at the level start pose)
L1_plan_A_expected_chrono_minus_referenc.solver: Newton (central-difference Jacobian, step 1e-7) on the 6 equilibrium equations / (W x gravity scale), max residual nonlinear 6.5e-14, linear 3.2e-10; linear = Richardson extrapolation of gravity x 0.0001 and x 0.0002 to the tangent

lift_V4_compliant_crawler.procedure: t < 0: machine settled on the crawler, legs fully retracted (initialise at the settled pose below). t = 0: all four motors start at +v_max. Each leg stops with a velocity step at its own e_op (rear first). Quasi-static statics (rate effects neglected), body rigid, crawler spheres and pads unilateral vertical springs (pads: L1 kn).
lift_V4_compliant_crawler.time_origin: t = 0 at motor start (not at simulation start)

crawler_contact_assumptions.gn_input_rule: gn = (damping_total / n_spheres) / m_eff, m_eff = superstructure body mass (crawler spheres are on that body; rods are separate bodies)
crawler_contact_assumptions.tangential: SMC kt = gt = mu = 0 (no crawler tangential force in L1; horizontal drift before pad touch not judged; no lift on a sloped floor with this model)

meta.basis: V4 judgement basis (user decision 2026-10-20): per-leg touch time within +-0.05 s of touch_s; quasi_static_events_s kept as a reference only
meta.model: Same model as run_leg_extension_loads.dynamic_check: M = m a a^T + blockdiag(0, I_xy), a = [1, cg_y, -cg_x], I_xy = roll/pitch block of the inertia about the CoM of superstructure (top) + 4 rods at e = 0 (rod x,y fixed); unilateral spring-dampers F = max(0, k c + c_d c_dot) for c > 0 (pads and crawler spheres), gravity on the CoM. Legs e(t) = min(v t, e_op) (V4 schedule, t = 0 = motor start). Start at t_from in the static pose on the crawler with zero velocity (exact: nothing moves the body before the first pad touch). Events: pad compression c_i = 0 (touch / loss) and max over crawler spheres c_j = 0 (crawler fully off / re-contact), located by solve_ivp.
meta.touch_definition: first time the pad compression c_i = e_i - touch_extension_i - (A q)_i turns positive (spring-damper force > 0 from that instant)

integrator.events: solve_ivp root finding on the pad and crawler compressions

dynamic_touch_damping_sensitivity.description: dynamic_events_s repeated with the pad dashpots scaled to the leg zeta (heave basis, crawler unchanged) and with the crawler dashpots scaled to the crawler zeta (pads unchanged); same integrator and window as dynamic_events_s

meta.model: Model (form (i), per leg, pad normal along +z at the ball centre; compression delta > 0): * moving leg (EXT / RET): N = k2 delta (head-only pad stiffness k2 = k_h (+) k_out, the L1 SMC k_n); * locked leg, anchor (delta_lock, N_lock) taken when the leg stops: N = N_lock + k1 (delta - delta_lock) below the knee, N = N_lock + dF_knee + k2 (delta - delta_lock - dF_knee / k1) above (rod side on its floor), k1 = (k_h + k_r) (+) k_out, dF_knee = (p_r0 - p_floor_gauge) A_ann / r, r = k_r / (k_h + k_r); * one pad dashpot c_n (LOCK basis, YAML cn_per_pad_N_s_m) in every state, tangential bushing k_t, c_t (stick). The 6-DoF replica (V5 step, V7b) is the rev. 13 ball-centre L1 model (dynamics_model.md 5.4, run_reference _l1_matrices: linear kinematics, preload geometric term) plus the piecewise normal law above as a generalised force; it is integrated with DOP853 (rtol 1e-11). No P-delta, no rod inertia (rods rigid with the body at e_op), no bushing yield, no lift-off (flagged if reached). Units SI, body frame x forward, y left, z up, level body = world axes, gravity -z (YAML meta.gravity_m_s2), angles rad (deg only in *_deg keys), leg order FL FR RL RR. Deterministic (no random numbers).
meta.frame: body x forward, y left, z up; level body = world axes; q about the CoM of superstructure + 4 rods at e_op
meta.pressure_convention: gauge Pa except p_floor (absolute in the YAML, gauge here = abs - 101325 Pa)
meta.lock_pressure_source: RULE (p_r0 after an extension = YAML actuator.rod_side.p_r0_after_extend_Pa, 2 bar g), dynamics_model.md 5.12.10

assumptions.replica: no P-delta, rods rigid with the body, no bushing yield, continuous time (no hook lag)

meta.integrator: scipy solve_ivp DOP853 rtol 1e-11, atol q 1e-14 m|rad, v 1e-12; output grid 0.0005 s
